name: pers_small_cap_catalyst_2026-09-25
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs
strategy: Bet on dated, primary-sourced binary catalysts in small and mid-cap biotech where the analyst revision flow is one-sidedly positive into the event, plus two GLP-1 picks-and-shovels names with zero analyst lowers. The edge is the pre-PDUFA drift documented in the research notes, not the decision-day pop, so I size for the CRL tail rather than the approval median and hold 14% cash to absorb it. I am wrong if a cluster of these PDUFAs draws CRLs on CMC or manufacturing grounds, if the FDA pushes dates past the 126-session window, or if the GLP-1 supply-chain names guide growth lower.
